comparison.objective: Relieve pressure, disconnect a hydraulic flat-face quick coupler, and cap it.
comparison.physical_skill: Pressure-safe release, coupler unlatching/extraction, and cap fitting versus setscrew loosening, collar adjustment, relocking, and cycle-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Depressurized, disconnected, capped coupling versus locked damper producing two safe stops under specified energy and velocity. Pressure and leakage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Both are industrial maintenance and include safety sequencing, but the mechanisms and tested abilities—disconnect/cap versus tune/retain/validate—are meaningfully different.
